title: Dataset on Energy Production Recorded by Corporación Eléctrica del Ecuador
dataset_summary: This dataset compiles information on the cumulative daily energy production of CELEC SUR's four main hydroelectric power plants in Ecuador.
data_type: Data on power generation and units produced by hydroelectric power plants.

annotations.source: Data obtained from CELEC's official source

relations_to_existing_work: Original information with data extracted from energy production charts and units generated by CELEC.

considerations_for_using_data.social_impact: Facilitates the analysis of energy production to improve decision making in the electricity sector.
considerations_for_using_data.bias_risks: Possible biases arising from the data extraction process (HTTP GET).
considerations_for_using_data.limitations: The data come from a single source and may contain errors.
